meta.name: AltstadtAuto Old Town
meta.credit: Old Town map by Louis Nordbø, from AltstadtAuto (https://wta.lou15.com). MIT License.
meta.axes: three.js, right-handed, y up. The code calls +z north (the river runs along x; the promenade and the cathedral are on the +z bank). The evening sun stands toward -x, -z.
meta.notes: Rects are axis-aligned x0..x1 by z0..z1. Fronts: zn = faces -z, zp = +z, xn = -x, xp = +x.

river.note: z0..z1 between the embankment walls; q0, q1 = the lower quays' inner edges

collision.note: boxes = walkable tops (minX..maxX, minZ..maxZ at height top); circles = walkable discs; solids = physics boxes (centre x,y,z, size w,h,d) and upright cylinders (centre, r, h)
